import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    S=p[0]+p[1]*x+p[2]*x**3+p[3]/v+p[4]*v+p[5]*np.sin(x)
    return S*(1+p[6]*t) + p[7]*t + p[8]*t*t + p[9]*t*x
